text: 经过两天辛苦劳作，你们用临时工具和方法造出一只木筏，足以冒险通过汉尼纳河下游的险恶水域。队伍装上所剩无几的财物，用撑杆驶入危险的河道。
接下来的几天，你们挣扎着穿过峡谷和急流，但木筏始终没有散架。也许你们因此过于自信了；在一段格外凶险的白水急流中，木筏被浪头抛起，随即船头朝下猛然栽入水中。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 51
text: Two days of work, using improvised tools and methods, produces a raft fit to dare the rough waters of the lower Hanninah. Your party loads its meager possessions and poles out into the hazardous channel.

In the days that follow, you struggle down canyons and rapids, but the raft holds. Perhaps you become overconfident, for in a particularly formidable patch of whitewater, the raft bounces on a surge and then plunges bow-first.
